The worlds of the [[Vland (system)|Vland system]] orbit around [[Urakkalan (star)|Urakkalan]], a yellow-white main sequence star both hotter and brighter then [[Sol (star)|Sol]]. 
* It is the [[Homeworld|home system]] of the branch of [[Humaniti]] known as the [[Vilani]].

== Description (Specifications) ==

=== Primary Star ===
The Vland system has a solitary primary star named ''[[Urakkalan (star)|Urakkalan]]''.
* It is a white main sequence.

{{MonostellarSystem
|name           = Vland
|PrimaryName    = [[Urakkalan (star)|Urakkalan]]
|primary        = F8 V 
|PrimaryNotes   = See ''[[Urakkalan (star)|Urakkalan]]'' for additional data.
}}

=== The Inner System ===
The inner system contains two intensely hot worlds and a [[planetoid belt]]:
* They receive very high levels of [[Electromagnetic Spectrum|stellar energy]].

[[File:Chart Orbit Inner Region Simple.png|600 px]]

'''Sagadir'''is the system's innermost world and experiences scorching temperatures.
* It is rarely visited.

'''Umiggash''', and Umiggahs's large moon '''Dinnika''' remain undeveloped balls of rock. 
* Umiggash and Dinnika are somewhat unusual, as their similarity in size makes them a [[Double World|double-planet system]]. 
*  These worlds are rarely visited, being of interest mainly to scientists.

The '''Khamiur Belt''' lies just starward of the [[habitable zone]].
* The belt's resources were mostly mined out by the start of the [[Interstellar Wars]]. Prospecting efforts continue, however, in a search for other, less valuable deposits. 

----

=== The [[Habitable Zone]] ===
[[Vland (world)|Vland]], the [[mainworld]] of the system, and its three moons orbit within the star's [[habitable zone]]:

[[File:Chart Orbit HZ Region Detailed.png|600 px]]

==== Vland's Moons ====
'''[[Vland (world)|Vland]]''' has three natural satellites; innermost ''Irukka'', well-colonized ''Gashema'', and large, distant ''Kalaguur''. The combined illumination provided by these three moons make dark nights virtually unknown. When all three moons are full, the night-time light level makes outdoor reading possible without artificial aid. 

* '''Irukka''' ia barren ball of rock orbiting roughly 170,000 km from [[Vland (world)|Vland]]. A small corporate mining and fueling station is maintained here, along with a government-operated weather surveillance post. The latter installation coordinates information from thousands of weather satellites circling [[Vland (world)|Vland]] in geostationary orbits. 

* '''[[Gashema (world)|Gashema]]''' is marginally habitable with its thin atmosphere and significant amount of free water. Orbiting [[Vland (world)|Vland]] at a distance 550,000 km, [[Gashema (world)|Gashema]] supports a thriving colony, a [[psychohistory|psychohistorical]] research station, and a military base - The operational headquarters of [[Vland (world)|Vland's]] [[COACC]]. 

* '''Kalaquur''' is a large satellite, nearly large enough to be a twin planet. A distant 720,000 km from Vland, Kalaquur is seldom visited. Its atmosphere - rich with sulfur compounds - is poisonous, and the only local settlement is a small corporate mining colony.

----

===The Outer System===
The outer system contains three frigidly cold worlds:

[[File:Chart Orbit Outer Region.png|600 px]]

'''Lirshala''' is a barren, uninhabited world.
* Lishala's small moon, '''Aga''', is equally barren.

'''Bikamakku''' is the next world out from Lirshala and is noteworthy only for its thin atmosphere and sizable ice caps.
* Bikamakhu has one satellite, '''Kaniirer''', an irregular body pockmarked with craters. 

'''Luukad''' is the outermost world in the Vland system. Beneath its dense methane atmosphere lie the majority of in-system naval facilities, including a capable shipyard.
* Despite Luukad's hostile environment, over three million people make their homes there.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==

==== System Timeline ====
Major events that have affected this system and the wider region that it lies within:
* [[-4045]] to [[-2204]]: the [[First Imperium|Ziru Sirka]] claims and settles worlds across the region.
* [[-2404]] to [[-2215]]: the [[Interstellar Wars]].
* [[-2204]] to [[-1776]]: the [[Rule of Man]] administers the worlds of the region.
* [[-1776]] to [[0]]: the [[Long Night]]. There is widespread regression within the area and some worlds [[Barren World|become barren]].
* [[0|The Year 0]]: the [[Third Imperium]] is founded.
* [[300]]-[[420]]: the [[First Survey]] charts the system.
* [[604]] to [[622]]: the {{Imperial}} [[Civil War]]. The region suffers disruption and widespread economic issues.
* [[624]]: the [[Express Boat Network]] is established, facilitating communications, trade, and economic growth within the area.
* [[995]]-[[1065]]: the [[Second Survey]] charts the system.
* [[1065]]: the [[Second Survey]] is published. Information about the system becomes widely available.
